layouts.description: Draft configuration: Historical street course follows Australia Avenue, Kevin Coombs Avenue, Edwin Flack Avenue, Dawn Fraser Avenue, Olympic Boulevard, Herb Elliot Avenue, Park Street and Murray Rose Avenue. The two southeastern street offsets and curved western perimeter match the supplied branch identity; Showground Road shortcuts and the wrong rectangular central loop are excluded. The operator identifies the event street sequence. Exact 2015 public road nodes form the complete loop. The public distance is 3423.3 m versus the supplied 3380 m scalar; temporary barrier placement and carriageway alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3423.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
